title: Elwynn Forest
content: Elwynn Forest is the starting zone for Human players in Stormwind. This peaceful forested area contains Northshire Abbey where new players learn basic skills. Key locations include Goldshire (the main town), Northshire Valley, and the forests around Stormwind. Common mobs include wolves, bears, kobolds, and bandits. Players can find quests from guards, farmers, and townsfolk. This zone teaches basic combat, gathering professions, and introduces players to World of Warcraft gameplay.

title: Durotar
content: Durotar is the starting zone for Orc and Troll players in Orgrimmar. This harsh desert and canyon region contains the Valley of Trials where new players learn basic skills. Key locations include Orgrimmar (the main city), Razor Hill, and the Echo Isles. Common enemies include boars, scorpids, quilboars, and centaurs. Players receive quests from various NPCs and learn about Horde culture and combat. This zone introduces players to shamanistic elements and Horde traditions.

title: Teldrassil
content: Teldrassil is the starting zone for Night Elf players in Darnassus. This massive tree contains Shadowglen where new players begin their journey. Key areas include Darnassus (the capital city), Dolanaar, and the forests of Teldrassil. Players learn druidic magic and nature-based combat. Common creatures include spiders, owls, and corrupted furbolgs. This zone emphasizes nature magic, stealth, and Night Elf culture.

title: Mulgore
content: Mulgore is the starting zone for Tauren players in Thunder Bluff. This vast plains region contains Bloodhoof Village where new players learn basic skills. Key locations include Thunder Bluff (the main city), Red Cloud Mesa, and the plains of Mulgore. Players learn about shamanism, hunting, and Tauren spirituality. Common enemies include wolves, cougars, and hostile centaurs. This zone teaches players about the elements and Tauren culture.

title: Dun Morogh
content: Dun Morogh is the starting zone for Dwarf and Gnome players in Ironforge. This mountainous region contains Anvilmar where new players begin. Key locations include Ironforge (the main city), Kharanos, and the Coldridge Valley. Players learn engineering, mining, and blacksmithing. Common enemies include troggs, wolves, and dark iron dwarves. This zone emphasizes technology, crafting, and dwarven culture.

title: Tirisfal Glades
content: Tirisfal Glades is the starting zone for Undead players in the Undercity. This haunted region contains Deathknell where new players rise as Forsaken. Key locations include the Undercity, Brill, and the forests of Tirisfal. Players learn about the Scourge, undeath, and Forsaken society. Common enemies include zombies, ghouls, and Scarlet Crusade members. This zone introduces players to the Forsaken struggle and undead themes.

title: Azuremyst Isle
content: Azuremyst Isle is the starting zone for Draenei players in the Exodar. This crashed spaceship island contains the Crash Site where new players begin. Key locations include the Exodar (the capital city), Azure Watch, and the forests of Azuremyst. Players learn about the Light, technology, and Draenei culture. Common enemies include nagas, owlbears, and corrupted wildlife. This zone introduces players to the Draenei exodus and their technological heritage.

title: Eversong Woods
content: Eversong Woods is the starting zone for Blood Elf players in Silvermoon City. This magical forest contains Sunstrider Isle where new players learn basic skills. Key locations include Silvermoon City, Falconwing Square, and the forests of Eversong. Players learn about arcane magic, addiction to magic, and Blood Elf society. Common enemies include wraiths, mana creatures, and hostile wildlife. This zone introduces players to Blood Elf culture and the magic addiction struggle.

title: Borean Tundra
content: Borean Tundra is a level 68-72 zone in Northrend, the icy northern continent. This frozen wasteland contains major cities like Valiance Keep (Alliance) and Warsong Hold (Horde). Key areas include the Riplash Ruins, the Geyser Fields, and the coastline. Players can find quests involving the Scourge, nerubians, and the blue dragonflight. This zone features diverse environments from icy plains to geothermal areas and introduces players to Northrend's harsh climate.

title: Howling Fjord
content: Howling Fjord is a level 68-72 zone in Northrend featuring dramatic fjords and viking-inspired settlements. Alliance players start at Valgarde while Horde players start at Camp Winterhoof. Key areas include Utgarde Keep, the Dragonflayer area, and the coastal regions. Players encounter vrykul, wolves, and various wildlife. This zone contains both questing areas and instances, making it a hub for Northrend adventurers.

title: Stormwind City
content: Stormwind is the capital of the Alliance, located in Elwynn Forest. Key districts include the Trade District, Old Town, the Dwarven District, and the Mage Quarter. Players find class trainers, the Auction House, banks, the Keep with King Varian Wrynn, and portals to major cities. Stormwind Harbor connects to Northrend via ship. The city is a hub for Alliance questing, trade, and social activity.

title: Orgrimmar
content: Orgrimmar is the Horde capital in Durotar. Key areas include the Valley of Strength, Valley of Honor, Valley of Wisdom, and the Cleft of Shadow. Warchief Thrall (later Garrosh) rules from Grommash Hold. The city hosts class trainers, the Auction House, banks, and zeppelin towers to Northrend and other regions. Orgrimmar is the primary Horde hub for trade, questing, and guild activity.

title: Dalaran
content: Dalaran is the floating mage city in Northrend, the main hub for level 80 players. It contains portals to all major cities, the Violet Hold dungeon entrance, banks, the Kirin Tor quartermaster, and the Eventide landing for cold weather flying training. Players use Dalaran as a staging point for dungeons, raids, and daily quests across Northrend. The city was relocated from Alterac to fight the Lich King.

title: The Barrens
content: The Barrens is a level 10-25 contested zone in central Kalimdor. Horde players travel through Crossroads and Camp Taurajo; Alliance players enter from the south. Key areas include Ratchet (goblin port), Wailing Caverns dungeon, and the Stonetalon Mountains border. The zone features quilboar, centaurs, and raptors. It is a classic leveling route and trade corridor connecting Horde territories.

title: Stranglethorn Vale
content: Stranglethorn Vale is a level 30-45 jungle zone in southern Eastern Kingdoms. Booty Bay is a neutral goblin port with the Booty Bay auction house. The zone contains trolls, panthers, and pirates. Zul'Gurub raid lies in the northern jungles. Players often level here for dense quest hubs and proximity to the Booty Bay-Northrend ship route in Wrath.

title: Western Plaguelands
content: Western Plaguelands is a level 50-58 zone corrupted by the Scourge. Key locations include Andorhal, Scholomance dungeon, and Chillwind Camp (Alliance). The Argent Dawn and Cenarion Circle have quest hubs here. Players fight undead and work toward reputation with the Argent Dawn. The zone connects to the Eastern Plaguelands and is part of the classic Scourge storyline.

title: Eastern Plaguelands
content: Eastern Plaguelands is a level 53-60 zone dominated by the Scourge. Stratholme dungeon sits in the north. Light's Hope Chapel hosts Argent Dawn quests. Naxxramas floats above the Carrion Fields in Wrath as a level 80 raid. Players fight undead, cultists, and corrupted wildlife while advancing the war against the Lich King's forces.

title: Dragonblight
content: Dragonblight is a level 71-74 zone in central Northrend. Wyrmrest Temple hosts the dragonflights and Obsidian Sanctum and Ruby Sanctum raids. The zone contains the Wrathgate storyline where Bolvar Fordragon falls and the Alliance and Horde briefly unite against the Scourge. Azjol-Nerub and Ahn'kahet dungeons lie beneath the zone. Naxxramas raid is located in the Carrion Fields.

title: Grizzly Hills
content: Grizzly Hills is a level 73-75 forested zone in eastern Northrend. Alliance base Amberpine Lodge and Horde base Conquest Hold anchor faction questing. The zone features furbolgs, vrykul, and the corrupted world tree Vordrassil. Drak'Tharon Keep dungeon is in neighboring Zul'Drak but quest lines tie in here. Grizzly Hills has a frontier logging and trapper atmosphere.

title: Zul'Drak
content: Zul'Drak is a level 74-77 zone home to the Drakkari ice trolls. The Drakkari have turned to dark loa worship and sacrifice their gods to fight the Scourge. Drak'Tharon Keep and Gundrak dungeons are located here. Key quest hubs include Zim'Torga and the Argent Stand. The zone has a grim troll empire theme with strong Scourge conflict.

title: Sholazar Basin
content: Sholazar Basin is a level 76-78 tropical zone in Northrend, created by the titans as a life experiment. The Oracles (frenzyheart rivals) and the Nesingwary safari quest line define the zone. Players fight lashers, gorillas, and proto-drakes. The zone connects to Un'Goro Crater thematically and offers unique reputation factions and daily quests.

title: Crystalsong Forest
content: Crystalsong Forest is a level 77-80 zone between Dragonblight and Icecrown. Dalaran floats above the crystalline trees. The zone has minimal questing but serves as a transit hub to Icecrown and Storm Peaks. The forest was transformed when blue dragons attempted to contain arcane energy from the Highborne ruins of Moonsong.

title: Storm Peaks
content: Storm Peaks is a level 77-80 mountainous zone in Northrend. Ulduar raid and Halls of Stone and Halls of Lightning dungeons are located here. K3 is a goblin mining town; Thorim and the frost giants feature in quest lines. The zone reveals titan history, vrykul culture, and the corrupted watcher Loken's legacy.

title: Icecrown
content: Icecrown is the level 77-80 endgame zone of Northrend. Icecrown Citadel raid and the Forge of Souls, Pit of Saron, and Halls of Reflection dungeons are here. The Argent Tournament Grounds host daily quests and Trial of the Champion dungeon and Trial of the Crusader raid. The Lich King sits on the Frozen Throne atop the citadel. Players advance the final assault against the Scourge.

title: Wintergrasp
content: Wintergrasp is a level 77-80 PvP zone in southern Northrend featuring massive faction battles for control of Wintergrasp Fortress. The controlling faction gains access to the Vault of Archavon raid inside the keep. Siege vehicles, destructible walls, and periodic battles make it unique open-world PvP. Players queue from Dalaran or fly in directly.

title: Un'Goro Crater
content: Un'Goro Crater is a level 50-55 zone in southern Kalimdor, a titan life experiment with dinosaurs, elementals, and rich herb nodes. Marshal's Refuge is the main hub. The zone connects thematically to Sholazar Basin in Northrend. Power crystals and the Linken quest chain are memorable features.

title: Silithus
content: Silithus is a level 55-60 desert zone and home to the silithid and qiraji threat. Cenarion Hold is the quest hub. Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj and Temple of Ahn'Qiraj raids lie in the south. Players farm elemental earth and work toward Cenarion Circle and Brood of Nozdormu reputation. The zone was the climax of Classic WoW's outdoor content.

title: Tanaris
content: Tanaris is a level 40-50 desert zone with Gadgetzan as the goblin hub. Zul'Farrak dungeon and Caverns of Time (CoT) entrance lie here. In Wrath, the Culling of Stratholme dungeon is accessed via CoT. Steamwheedle Cartel quests and pirates define the zone.

title: Feralas
content: Feralas is a level 40-50 lush jungle zone with Feathermoon Stronghold (Alliance) and Camp Mojache (Horde). Dire Maul dungeon complex sits in the east. The zone features ogres, harpies, and the twin colossals. Classic high-level outdoor content.

title: The Hinterlands
content: The Hinterlands is a level 45-50 highland zone with Aerie Peak (Alliance) and Revantusk Village (Horde). Wildhammer dwarves, trolls, and the green dragonflight feature in quests. Reputation with Wildhammer or Revantusk unlocks rewards.

title: Winterspring
content: Winterspring is a level 55-60 snowy zone in northern Kalimdor. Everlook is the neutral goblin town. Players hunt frostsabers, fight demons from the Burning Legion, and complete epic hunter quest chains. Connects to Moonglade and Felwood.

title: Felwood
content: Felwood is a level 48-55 corrupted forest zone. Players fight satyrs, demons, and corrupted treants while aiding the Cenarion Circle. Timbermaw Hold reputation is key here. The zone bridges Ashenvale to Winterspring and Mount Hyjal.

title: Burning Steppes
content: Burning Steppes is a level 52-58 zone dominated by Blackrock Mountain. Morgan's Vigil (Alliance) and Flame Crest (Horde) are hubs. Lower/Upper Blackrock Spire, Blackrock Depths, and Molten Core raid entrance are here. Dark Iron dwarves and dragons populate the area.

title: Dustwallow Marsh
content: Dustwallow Marsh is a level 35-45 swamp zone with Theramore Isle (Alliance) and Brackenwall Village (Horde). Onyxia's Lair raid entrance is in the Wyrmbog. The zone features dragonkin, murlocs, and the infamous 'missing diplomat' quest chain.

title: Ashenvale
content: Ashenvale is a level 18-30 contested forest zone between Alliance and Horde. Astranaar and Splintertree Post are faction hubs. Warsong Gulch battleground entrance and Blackfathom Deeps dungeon border the zone. Heavy PvP and night elf vs orc conflict.

title: Thousand Needles
content: Thousand Needles is a level 25-35 canyon zone in Kalimdor, flooded in later expansions but dry in Wrath. Freewind Post (Horde) and Thalanaar (Alliance) anchor questing. Centaurs, harpies, and the Shimmering Flats raceway are notable features.

title: Desolace
content: Desolace is a level 30-40 barren zone with Nijel's Point (Alliance) and Shadowprey Village (Horde). Maraudon dungeon lies in the Valley of Spears. Centaurs, satyrs, and the neutral Magram and Gelkis centaur clans define questing.

title: Ironforge
content: Ironforge is the dwarven and gnomish capital in Dun Morogh. The Great Forge, Mystic Ward, and Hall of Explorers are key districts. Alliance players access deeprun tram to Stormwind. King Magni Bronzebeard rules before his crystallization in Wrath events.

title: Undercity
content: Undercity is the Forsaken capital beneath Lordaeron ruins in Tirisfal Glades. Sylvanas Windrunner rules from the Royal Quarter. The Apothecarium, Magic Quarter, and Rogue Quarter serve undead players. Zeppelin to Northrend departs from Tirisfal towers nearby.

title: Darnassus
content: Darnassus is the night elf capital atop Teldrassil. The Temple of the Moon, Tradesmen's Terrace, and Cenarion Enclave serve Alliance druids and night elves. Tyrande Whisperwind leads the city. Port to Azuremyst Isle connects draenei allies.

title: Shattrath City
content: Shattrath is the neutral TBC hub in Terokkar Forest, rebuilt by naaru. Aldor and Scryer factions compete for player allegiance. Portals to Outland zones and daily heroic quests make it essential for level 70 content. No auction house until later expansions.

title: Silvermoon City
content: Silvermoon City is the blood elf capital in Eversong Woods. The Sunfury Spire, Farstriders Square, and Murder Row serve Horde casters and paladins. Kael'thas's legacy and the Scourge invasion of Quel'Thalas define the city's story. Portal master connects to major cities.

title: The Exodar
content: The Exodar is the draenei capital crashed on Azuremyst Isle. The Vault of Lights and Traders Tier serve Alliance draenei. Naaru technology and the Exodar's crystal architecture reflect draenei heritage. Links to Bloodmyst Isle questing.

title: Redridge Mountains
content: Redridge Mountains is a level 15-25 Alliance zone east of Stormwind. Lakeshire is the hub. Blackrock orc invasions and the Stonewatch keep quest line are memorable. Players defend the zone from orc raids and connect to Burning Steppes later.

title: Duskwood
content: Duskwood is a level 18-30 Alliance zone of haunted forests and undead. Darkshire is defended by the Night Watch. Mor'Ladim, Stitches, and the Defias brotherhood remnants create a gothic horror atmosphere. Connects Westfall to Stranglethorn.

title: Westfall
content: Westfall is a level 10-20 Alliance farming zone. Sentinel Hill opposes the Defias Brotherhood. The Deadmines dungeon tells the VanCleef story. Players investigate harvest golem attacks and economic collapse after the First War.

title: Loch Modan
content: Loch Modan is a level 10-20 Alliance zone between Dun Morogh and Wetlands. Thelsamar is the hub. Trogg invasions, the Stonewrought Dam, and the Loch Modan yeti quest are classic experiences. The zone teaches low-level Alliance players.

title: Wetlands
content: Wetlands is a level 20-30 Alliance swamp zone connecting Khaz Modan to Arathi. Menethil Harbor offers boat routes. Dragonmaw orcs, raptors, and the Greenwarden define questing. Notorious for confusing terrain before map addons.

title: Blasted Lands
content: Blasted Lands is a level 45-55 zone south of the Dark Portal. The portal to Outland opens here at level 58. Demons, ogres, and the Dark Portal defenders anchor endgame classic content. Nethergarde Keep (Alliance) watches the portal.

title: Swamp of Sorrows
content: Swamp of Sorrows is a level 35-45 zone with Stonard (Horde) and the Sunken Temple dungeon. The zone connects to Blasted Lands and features dragons, orcs, and bog beasts. Horde players often pass through en route to the Dark Portal.
